spans.s: शोचक, अस्, इका, अम्, afflictive, distressing.

शोचत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sorrowing, grieving, lament-
ing, bewailing.

शोचन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, sorrowing, lamenting, sor-
rowful; causing or producing sorrow, afflicting, griev-
ing; (अम्), n. sorrow, grief, grieving, mourning.
शोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, grieving, sorrowing, mourning.

1. शोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing grief or sorrow,
distressing, afflicting, grieving.

2. शोचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to shine, bright-
ening, illuminating.

शोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to grieve, made sad,
saddened; afflicted; sorrowful.

शोचितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be grieved or mourned,
lamentable, deplorable.
शोचित्वा, ind. having grieved or mourned.

1. शोच्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. शोच्य see col. 2), to
be lamented or bewailed, to be mourned.

2. शोच्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. शोच्य see col. 1), to
be cleansed; requiring purification, wicked.
शोच, shining &c., in शुक्र-शोच, q. v.
शोच शोच, शोचिस्, &c. See under rt. 3. शुच्.

शोचिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining very much,
most brilliant.

शोचिस्, इस्, n. light, lustre, radiance; a flame, blast
of fire.
—शोचिष्-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having (rays
of) light for hair, having flaming locks; epithet of
the sun; of Agni; (अस्), m. fire or its deity.
—शो-
चिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of lustre,
effulgent, radiant.

शोच्यक, अस्, m. one who requires purifying, a
low man, vile or base person.
